DIFFERENTIAL VS REAL GIT (git 2.55.0) - hard requirement
A) Advertisement round-trip: created a scratch repo (tempfile dir), one commit, ran `git -c protocol.version=0 upload-pack --advertise-refs .`. Parsed the raw stdout with MY read_pkt, frame by frame:
   - each frame consumed exactly payload.len()+4 bytes (asserted start/end cursor delta);
   - encode_pkt(parsed_payload) reproduced the ORIGINAL git bytes for every frame;
   - concatenation of re-encoded frames == git's raw stdout BYTE-FOR-BYTE;
   - last frame is Flush; first frame is <40-hex oid> + " HEAD" + NUL + capabilities; >=2 Data frames including a refs/heads/ line.
B) Write direction + side-band: built a request with write_pkt("want <oid> side-band-64k\n") + write_flush() + write_pkt("done\n"), fed it to `git -c protocol.version=0 upload-pack --stateless-rpc <gitdir>`: git exit 0 (no protocol error), stdout re-parsed with read_pkt: first frame Data "NAK", terminated by Flush, and side-band channel bytes 0x01/0x02 were preserved verbatim inside Pkt::Data (not stripped/split).

STRUCTURAL BOUNDARIES (all asserted)
- 0000/0001/0002 return Flush/Delim/ResponseEnd immediately (4-byte buffers, no payload read); 0004 -> Data(vec![]).
- max payload 65516 -> header "fff0"; 65520 total bytes consumed.
- multi-frame single buffer (Data one, Delim, Data two, ResponseEnd, Flush) -> successive read_pkt calls, cursor positions exactly 7/11/18/22/26.
- write_pkt round-trips through read_pkt; write output for "hello\n"+flush+empty == "000ahello\n00000004"; write_flush emits literal "0000".
- rejection counterexamples truly fail with Err(Error::Protocol), no panic and no partial data: lengths 0003 and ffff; non-hex zzzz/00g0/" 004"; truncations ""/00/000/0008/0008ab (header promises 8, only 2 payload bytes).
- write_pkt with 65517-byte payload -> Err(Error::Protocol) and nothing written.

KNOWN LIMITATIONS / NOT COVERED
- read_pkt accepts uppercase hex digits as well as lowercase (real git's packet_length does the same); the writer always emits lowercase. This is an intentional superset for interop with real git.
- There is no EOF sentinel: EOF at a frame boundary (or a clean end-of-stream) yields Err(Error::Protocol), since Pkt has no Eof variant. Callers must stop on Flush/Delim/ResponseEnd rather than relying on EOF.
- The 2 differential tests require a real `git` on PATH and will fail (not skip) if absent - by design for this interop project. They create repos only under tempfile::tempdir(); commit identity/date are set per-command via Command::env, no GIT_* variable is exported into the test process.
- Scope: only transport::pktline implemented. src/transport/{http,local,negotiate}.rs (T13/T14), v2 capability negotiation, and any new dependency are untouched (none needed).
